# General vectors for purse-snacl
#
# Every expected value is the output of the Go oracle tools/oracle/cmd/snacl, built with
# go1.27.4, which links dcrwallet 54b85b336077587eaf20112dc695355ce06fc76e's
# kdf and udb packages, a verbatim copy of its wallet/internal/snacl and a verbatim copy
# of udb's seal/unseal. Regenerate with:
#   PURSE_SNACL_REGEN=1 PURSE_REQUIRE_ORACLE=1 cargo test -p purse-snacl --test oracle \
#       -- --ignored regenerate_frozen_vectors
# which also checks the Rust crate agrees. Do not edit by hand.
# Regeneration does not reproduce this file byte for byte: Go draws salts, nonces and
# keys from github.com/decred/dcrd/crypto/rand, a generator seeded from the operating
# system that the oracle cannot steer, and later requests are built from earlier
# answers. So tests/oracle.rs replays every entry (and the database) against Go on
# every run with the oracle: deterministic requests must give the recorded outcome
# again, and each random draw is checked by its inverse (the key derived again from
# the recorded parameters, the recorded box opened to the recorded plaintext).
# Inputs: tests/common/mod.rs build_corpus with SplitMix64(0x736e61636c000001); later requests
# use earlier answers. Each line is {cmd, args, outcome}: the request as sent and Go's
# outcome, in the shapes tools/oracle/cmd/snacl/main.go documents. Lines with a
# "divergence" member pin a recorded difference (see the crate docs).
#
# entries: 1178
# count account-seal: 27
# count account-unseal: 75
# count argon2-derive: 59
# count argon2-marshal: 101
# count argon2-new-params: 7
# count argon2-unmarshal: 22
# count crypto-decrypt: 136
# count crypto-encrypt: 20
# count derive-key: 290
# count generate-crypto-key: 6
# count marshal: 24
# count new-secret-key: 68
# count seal: 30
# count secret-decrypt: 129
# count secret-encrypt: 20
# count unmarshal: 31
# count unseal: 133
